class.name: JRPGEventCommand
class.brief_description: One event command: its parameters, child lists and metadata.
class.description: The base of every event command. Its parameters are the subclass's stored properties; a branch command also has child [JRPGCommandList]s, named by [method get_child_list_names]. Commands are never saved one by one: the list that holds them packs them ([method pack]) and builds them again from that ([method unpack]). A subclass says what it is through the metadata methods: [method get_code] (stable, since saved lists hold it), [method get_category], [method get_display_name] and [method get_summary] for the event editor, [method get_authority] (who runs it online), [method get_usable_in], [method can_wait] and [method get_id_parameters] (the parameters that are database IDs, for the reference checks). Command classes are registered with [JRPGCommandRegistry]. Authority: each command declares its own ([method get_authority]).

method.name: can_wait
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the command can make the interpreter wait (a message, a wait, a move route to finish).

method.name: get_authority
method.description: Returns who runs the command online: the server (it changes game state), the client (it only presents) or both.

method.name: get_category
method.description: Returns the event editor category the command is listed in.

method.name: get_child_list_names
method.description: Returns the names of the properties that hold the command's child lists (the branches of a branch command), in order.

method.name: get_code
method.description: Returns the code saved lists hold for this command. It must never change once lists have been saved with it; the class name unless a subclass gives another.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the command's name in the event editor.

method.name: get_id_parameters
method.description: Returns a dictionary [code]{parameter name: table name}[/code] of the parameters that hold database IDs, for the reference checks ([JRPGReferenceScanner]).

method.name: get_parameter_names
method.description: Returns the names of the parameters [method pack] writes: the stored properties, without the child lists and the engine's own properties.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns one line describing the command with its parameters, for the event editor.

method.name: get_usable_in
method.description: Returns where the command may be used: map events, battle events, common events.

method.name: pack
method.description: Returns the command as a list stores it: [code][lb]code, {parameter: value}, {child list name: packed list}[rb][/code].

method.name: unpack
method.description: Takes the parameters and child lists from [param packed] (as [method pack] writes it). Parameters the command does not have (or no longer has) are left out with a warning; the script and the engine's own properties are never set this way.

constants.constant: Messages: text, choices, number input, item selection, scrolling text.
Game progression: switches, variables, self switches, timers.
Flow control: branches, loops, labels, common events, comments.
Party: gold, items, weapons, armors, members.
Actors: HP, MP, TP, states, experience, levels, parameters, skills, equipment, names, classes, images.
Movement: transfers, vehicles, event locations, scrolling, move routes, getting on and off.
Characters: transparency, followers, animations, balloons, erasing events.
Pictures: show, move, rotate, tint, erase.
Timing: waits.
Screen: fades, tints, flashes, shakes, weather.
Audio and video: music, ambience, sound effects, movies.
Scene control: battles, shops, name input, menus, saving, game over, the title screen.
System settings: music, window color, access to save, menu, encounters and formation, vehicle images.
Map: map name display, tilesets, battle backgrounds, parallax, location information.
Battle: enemy and actor changes during a battle.
Advanced: scripts and other commands for authors who know the engine.
